panels.title: Where the robot's gripper is (cm)
panels.description: Position of the robot's hand in 3D space, over time. side = left/right, up = height, forward = away from the base.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, ee_x AS "forward", ee_y AS "up", ee_z AS "side" FROM robot_state WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Shoulder rotation angle (radians)
panels.description: Angle of the robot's shoulder joint (joint 0). 0 rad = straight ahead.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, joints[1] AS "shoulder rotation" FROM robot_state WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Live updates in the last 5 minutes
panels.description: How many state snapshots the simulator sent us in the last 5 minutes. Should be ~3,000 during an active run (10 per second). If this is 0, the pipeline is idle.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "updates received" FROM robot_state WHERE ts > now() - interval '5 minutes'
